name: Pouncing Tiger Haunt
description: A cave painting of a great cat roars to life and leaps off the wall to attack.
disable: DC 18 Nature check (trained) or DC 18 Religion check (trained) to quell the spirit
reset: If the cave painting isn't destroyed, the haunt resets after 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tiger Slash
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 5 feet of the cave painting

Effect The haunt deals 4d8 slashing damage with semisolid claws (DC 18 basic Will save). On a failed save, the target is also Frightened 1 and Fleeing for 1 round (or Frightened 2 and fleeing for 1 minute on a critical failure).
